tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The ground. Page and app background; the paper everything rests on.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, controls at rest, the knob of a toggle. One step toward the viewer.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Tracks, wells, segmented-control rails, code blocks. One step away from the viewer.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Sheets, popovers, menus and toasts: anything that floats above a scrim or the page.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface token (15:1+ light, 13:1+ dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions, inactive tabs, on every surface token and on stone (4.5:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, placeholders, helper text. On every surface token (4.5:1+). Never on stone.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and section rules. Separates; never identifies a control.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Edges of cards and sheets where shadow alone is not enough. Decorative.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control: text fields, unchecked boxes, the outline of a quiet button. 3:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: The material tint: selected rows, segmented-control indicator on sunken rails, a toggle track at off. Ink or ink-muted on it.

tokens.name: fill-primary
tokens.usage: The single primary action and a toggle at on: graphite in light, bone in dark. Text on it is on-fill-primary.

tokens.name: on-fill-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on fill-primary (15:1+).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one coloured thing in the room, a deep cobalt: focus rings, live and in-progress state, the current step. Never decoration, never status. 5.1:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet background behind signal-coloured text or a live indicator.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a signal fill (6:1+). Deep navy ink on the dark theme's lighter signal.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in the surface colour, then a solid 2px ring. 3:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Success text and icons, always with a word or a check glyph. Teal leans off the red-green axis.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Background for positive notices; positive or ink text on it.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Caution text and icons, always with a word or a glyph.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Background for caution notices; caution or ink text on it.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive confirmation, always with a word or a glyph. Red, set apart from signal's blue by hue; never rely on colour alone.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Background for error notices; critical or ink text on it.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the scene behind a sheet or dialog. Fades in with the layer, never ahead of it.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per scene: the opening statement of a story or a landing moment.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Chapter openers, empty states that carry a message.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Page titles inside the product. Sentence case.

styles.name: pull-quote
styles.usage: The single idea a reader should leave with. Italic, never bold.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Sheet and panel titles; card titles when a card is the main object.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a panel or form group.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Changes are saved as you go.
styles.usage: Default reading and interface text. 60-72 characters per line.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Descriptions under a label, metadata, dense lists.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, field labels, menu items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Overlines and tiny labels. Uppercase allowed here only, tracked +0.02em.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Key figures. Tabular numerals; figures align on the decimal.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, IDs, keyboard shortcuts, tabular data cells.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside a control; hairline insets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tightly related items: a label and its field, chips in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding (vertical in large controls), list-item gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default control horizontal padding; card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between form groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel and sheet padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margins at desktop; top of a scene before its headline.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between chapters of a story page. Stillness lives here.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Rare: the pause before and after a display-xl statement.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, inline code, tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Text fields, small buttons, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, segmented controls, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets and dialogs: the largest objects carry the softest corners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, toggles, avatars, the toggle knob.

shadow.note: Elevation is a material property, not decoration: each step is a hairline contact shadow plus one soft ambient shadow. Lift by one step on hover or drag, never two.

tokens.name: shadow-rest
tokens.usage: Controls and cards at rest: sits on the surface.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered or picked-up cards, a dragged item.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, toasts: detached from the page.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and dialogs over a scrim.

tokens.name: shadow-knob
tokens.usage: Small physical parts that move: toggle knobs, slider thumbs.

duration.note: For CSS-only transitions. Interactive motion uses springs (settle-motion.js); these durations pair with the spring curves below so CSS and JS feel the same.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Colour and opacity response to press; hover tint.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Small exits, tooltip fade, icon swap.

tokens.name: dur-snappy
tokens.usage: Pairs with ease-spring-snappy: toggles, segmented indicator, press release.

tokens.name: dur-gentle
tokens.usage: Pairs with ease-spring-gentle: disclosure height, layout shifts.

tokens.name: dur-settle
tokens.usage: Pairs with ease-spring-settle: entrances that land, toasts, popovers.

tokens.name: dur-scene
tokens.usage: Pairs with ease-spring-heavy: scene changes, sheets, shared-element transitions.

easing.note: cubic-bezier curves for simple fades; linear() curves are sampled from the four springs in settle-motion.js (Settle.springs) and must be paired with their dur- token.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entrances without overshoot: fades, colour, opacity.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Elements that move between two resting places on screen without user input.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Exits only: things leaving accelerate away; they never bounce out.

tokens.name: ease-spring-snappy
tokens.usage: stiffness 520, damping 34 (zeta 0.75, 3% overshoot). Small parts under the finger.

tokens.name: ease-spring-settle
tokens.usage: stiffness 300, damping 22 (zeta 0.64, 7% overshoot). The signature: arrives, overshoots a touch, settles.

tokens.name: ease-spring-gentle
tokens.usage: stiffness 220, damping 24 (zeta 0.81, 1% overshoot). Size and layout changes.

tokens.name: ease-spring-heavy
tokens.usage: stiffness 160, damping 26, mass 1.6 (zeta 0.81). Large surfaces with believable weight.
